invalid_link: This link isn't right or was already used. Make a new one on a signed-in device
title: Connect to Persona
subtitle: Let this browser in from a device that's already signed in.
phone_title: Sign in with your signed-in phone
phone_step_open: On a signed-in phone or computer, open {path} and choose Browser.
phone_path: Settings › Devices › Connect a new device
phone_step_scan: On a phone or tablet, scan the code with the camera. It opens and signs you in.
phone_step_copy: To sign in on this computer, tap Copy sign-in link there, then open it here or paste it below.
link_placeholder: Paste a sign-in or pairing link
credential_note: This browser gets its own credentials. You can revoke them anytime in Settings › Devices.
no_hub_what: The hub is the Persona service on an always-on computer (a home computer, NAS or server). Your phone and the web both connect to it. This page is served by a hub.
no_hub_yours: If you set it up: it showed a QR code when it was installed. Scan that with Persona on your phone first, then follow the steps above for this browser.
no_hub_others: If someone else set it up: ask them to make a sign-in link for you on a signed-in device.
advanced: Advanced: sign in with the hub's master key
master_warning: This is the hub's master key. Whoever has it can do anything, so don't share it. This browser trades it for its own credentials and doesn't keep it.
master_where: On the hub machine, run {pair} or {jq}.
password_pairing: Scan or use a pairing link
qr_expired: Code expired. Refresh to try again.
qr_failed: Could not load the sign-in code. Try again.
qr_hint: Scan in the signed-in Persona phone app, then confirm to sign in here. The code expires in 5 minutes.
